**University of Liverpool**

Plasmid manipulation of bacterial behaviour in *Pseudomonas aeruginosa*.

<details class="project-details">
<summary>Project details & methods</summary>

Investigating how antimicrobial-resistance plasmids alter bacterial behaviour and evolutionary dynamics, with a focus on plasmid–host interactions, social behaviour and adaptation.

**Methods:** bacterial phenotyping · microbial genetics · experimental evolution · quantitative analysis

</details>

## MRes — Gut Microbial Genomics {.timeline-title}

**University of Liverpool**

Comparative genomics of Clostridia in healthy and diarrhoeal gut microbiomes.

<details class="project-details">
<summary>Project details & methods</summary>

Investigated genomic and ecological differences in gut Clostridia, with particular focus on *Clostridium perfringens*, virulence-associated variation and strain diversity.

**Methods:** shotgun metagenomics · MAG recovery · diversity analysis · ANI · phylogenomics · HPC

</details>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-date}
2024–2025
:::
::: {.timeline-card}
## BSc - Plant-Microbe Interactions {.timeline-title}

**University of Liverpool**

Rhizobacteria, aphids and barley yellow dwarf virus.

<details class="project-details">
<summary>Project details & methods</summary>

Investigated whether rhizobacterial inoculation could alter barley responses to *Sitobion avenae* and aphid-vectored barley yellow dwarf virus.

**Methods:** bacterial culture · plant/aphid experiments · DAS-ELISA · mixed-effects modelling

</details>
:::
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
::: {.timeline-date}
Summer 2024
:::
::: {.timeline-card}
## UNIQ+ Research Internship - Photosynthesis Evolution {.timeline-title}

**University of Oxford**

Plasmodesmata distribution across the C3–C4 evolutionary gradient in *Flaveria*.

<details class="project-details">
<summary>Project details & methods</summary>

Investigated changes in mesophyll–bundle sheath connectivity during the evolution of C4 photosynthesis.

**Methods:** FIB-SEM · confocal microscopy · image segmentation · 3D reconstruction

</details>
:::
:::
